description: Repairs r-lock-3-4-txn/txn-view-readers: b's reads came 17 to 60 ms after a's commit and after b's own earlier reads, so b's read cache was confounded with transaction visibility. Process b holds a snapshot, dynaset, forward-only and table-type cursor over rows 1, 2 and 64 opened before any transaction. Process a begins a transaction and updates N of row 1; b waits 7 s, reads each held cursor (Move 0, read, Transactions) and opens new cursors. Process a commits; b waits 7 s, reads the held cursors without Requery, then Requery on each and reads, then new cursors. Process a begins, updates and b (after 7 s) reads held and new cursors; a rolls back; b (after 7 s) reads without and then with Requery.
